verdicts.reason: The two candidates are almost pixel-identical; B's logo sits only a few pixels higher than A's. Both are a uniformly shrunk copy of the square with no rearrangement. The large maroon circle now runs up into the end of the quote and the attribution, the 'SOLSTICE' wordmark and the can label are too small to read at 300×250, and the attribution line is tiny. The can is jammed against the bottom edge while the right half above it is empty.
